catalogue_policy.capability_evidence: Only classify OUT_OF_SCOPE_GRIDCRAFT/SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE when there is a recorded native capability gate; a missing VBA descriptor alone is not proof of a missing spreadsheet feature.
catalogue_policy.low: DEFERRED_LOW regardless of backing eligibility; preserve existing runtime metadata/package fidelity without implementing new Low behavior.
catalogue_policy.unselected_high: Keep High priority and the literal MISSING/PARTIAL state. Reference extensions outside the already accepted native obligations are not certified, silently downgraded or falsely labeled product gaps. They require explicit capability review/reprioritization before becoming new runtime work.
catalogue_policy.unselected_medium: Retain exact pages and native gaps/service dependencies outside the selected Medium ledgers.
